label: openGym webhooks
info:
Receives openGym webhooks, checks the signature, timestamp and delivery id, and hands authentic events to a demo handler.

Set OPENGYM_WEBHOOK_SECRET in the Node-RED environment to the signing secret openGym showed when you added the webhook. See contrib/node-red/README.md.
